tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search active listings: suppliers, services, APIs and data sources. Free text in English or Spanish. Paid placements come only in sponsored_results (at most 3). The response includes an invitation to tell the hub what you did not find.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One active listing by id (from search_listings), in the requested language.

tools.name: send_interest
tools.description: Tell the hub what you (or your owner) offer, or what you searched and did not find. kind: 'offer' or 'missing'. Free text, English or Spanish, 10 to 2000 characters. Stored for the hub team and NEVER published. No personal data.
